searchText: I'm bringing here the attestations data index topic I pointed out during the last breakout https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1744#issuecomment-3389244599 and would like to gather some feedbacks Maybe this was mentioned in the beacon-API discussions, but I think the beacon node events need to be extended to allow notifying the VC that a local bid has been accepted so that it can call the BN to get the unsigned payload, sign it and send it to the BN. I was thinking adding "builder_index" to the head event or a new "execution_payload_bid" event. Any thoughts? As of EIP-4895, zero-amount withdrawals are not possible. With the current payment logic in 7732, it would be possible to create 0 amount withdrawals. This wouldn't break anything, also the EL would just handle them as a no-op but it would still mean the EL would load the withdrawal recipient account into cache and create an entry in the withdrawal trie, which might not be needed. This would be a minimal fix: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4651 I think we always sign it premptively and cache the whole thing We're not creating zero value withdrawals I think perhaps the only case I may have forgotten is the case in which the builder is slashed and loses all of itsv stake. I'll check if that case is not covered later Right yeah, that's the situation I was thinking of. It could happen if a builder validator incurs penalizations (missed attestations, proposals, sync committee contributions) which cause its balance to be less than the min activation balance, no? Yeah it could Ahh right, this guard looks good to me, nice one. I worry about `process_withdrawals` that has become horrible and now it's pretty tangled with `get_expected_withdrawals`. In particular, the removal of the builder pending withdrawals, that stay in the list even if they aren't added as withdrawals is worrisome. Merged 👍

excerpts.author: stefanbratanov
excerpts.content: Maybe this was mentioned in the beacon-API discussions, but I think the beacon node events need to be extended to allow notifying the VC that a local bid has been accepted so that it can call the BN to get the unsigned payload, sign it and send it to the BN. I was thinking adding "builder_index" to the head event or a new "execution_payload_bid" event. Any thoughts?

excerpts.author: nero_eth
excerpts.content:
As of EIP-4895, zero-amount withdrawals are not possible. With the current payment logic in 7732, it would be possible to create 0 amount withdrawals.
This wouldn't break anything, also the EL would just handle them as a no-op but it would still mean the EL would load the withdrawal recipient account into cache and create an entry in the withdrawal trie, which might not be needed.
This would be a minimal fix:
https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4651

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: I think we always sign it premptively and cache the whole thing

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: We're not creating zero value withdrawals

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: I think perhaps the only case I may have forgotten is the case in which the builder is slashed and loses all of itsv stake. I'll check if that case is not covered later

excerpts.author: nero_eth
excerpts.content: Right yeah, that's the situation I was thinking of.

In particular, the removal of the builder pending withdrawals, that stay in the list even if they aren't added as withdrawals is worrisome.
